description: Recommended values for a workout's classification.workoutType. Open by policy — the value labels a session, it does not change how the document is read (RFC-007 §3.2).

entries.label: Strength
entries.description: A session built around force production in a small number of lifts.

entries.label: Hypertrophy
entries.description: A session built around accumulated volume.

entries.label: Mobility
entries.description: A session whose target is usable range of motion.

entries.label: Hybrid
entries.description: Strength and conditioning in one session, neither subordinate to the other.

entries.label: Circuit
entries.description: A session whose defining feature is circuit traversal. Note this is a label — the structure is carried by blocks[].mode.

entries.label: Class
entries.description: A coached group session, where the format rather than the individual prescription is the identity.

entries.label: Recovery
entries.description: Deliberately low-stress work intended to aid recovery.

entries.label: Test
entries.description: A session whose purpose is measurement — a max attempt, a benchmark, a retest.

entries.label: Power
entries.description: A session built around velocity and rate of force development.

entries.label: Isometric
entries.description: A session built around held positions rather than movement through a range.
